# Remote Work Policy

## Work Arrangement Options

The company operates a hybrid-first model. Employees in roles that don't
require physical presence (labs, manufacturing floors, on-site client work)
may work remotely up to 3 days per week, with at least 2 days in the office
for team collaboration. Fully remote arrangements require director-level
approval and are reviewed every 6 months.

## Eligibility

Remote work eligibility is based on role, not tenure. Employees should
confirm with their manager whether their role qualifies before making any
arrangement. New hires typically complete their first 60 days on-site to
support onboarding, after which the standard hybrid arrangement described
above applies.

## Equipment and Expenses

The company provides a laptop, monitor, and standard peripherals for remote
work. A one-time home office stipend of $500 is available for employees on
an approved hybrid or remote arrangement, covering items such as a desk,
chair, or monitor. Ongoing internet costs are not reimbursed unless the role
is classified as fully remote.

## Core Hours and Communication

Remote employees are expected to be reachable during core hours of 10 AM to
4 PM local time and to attend scheduled team meetings with video on. Status
should be kept current in the company messaging tool so teammates know when
someone is working remotely versus in the office.

## Working From Another Location

Employees who wish to work temporarily from a different city or country
(for example, visiting family) may do so for up to 4 weeks per year with
manager approval, provided the location does not create tax, legal, or data
security complications for the company.
